parameters.query: select e.prospect_id, e.borr_name, p.is_acquisition, p.gross_approval, e.borr_city, e.borr_state, e.campaign_track, e.computed_lead_score, e.outreach_status, e.total_touches, e.latest_outcome, e.next_followup_at, coalesce(nullif(btrim(e.owner_email), ''), '') as best_email, coalesce(nullif(btrim(e.owner_phone), ''), nullif(btrim(e.google_phone), ''), '') as best_phone, p.website_url, p.friction_tags from public.v_sba_prospect_engagement e join public.sba_prospects p on p.id = e.prospect_id where e.outreach_status not in ('booked', 'won', 'archived', 'disqualified') and e.next_followup_at is not null and e.next_followup_at <= (date_trunc('day', now() at time zone 'America/New_York') + interval '1 day') at time zone 'America/New_York' order by e.next_followup_at asc, e.computed_lead_score desc, p.is_acquisition desc limit 15;

select e.prospect_id, e.borr_name, p.is_acquisition, p.gross_approval, p.google_review_count, e.borr_city, e.borr_state, e.campaign_track, e.computed_lead_score, e.outreach_status, p.website_url, p.friction_tags, coalesce(nullif(btrim(e.owner_email), ''), '') as best_email, coalesce(nullif(btrim(e.owner_phone), ''), nullif(btrim(e.google_phone), ''), '') as best_phone from public.v_sba_prospect_engagement e join public.sba_prospects p on p.id = e.prospect_id where e.total_touches = 0 and e.outreach_status in ('new', 'enriched', 'ready') and e.computed_lead_score >= 60 order by e.computed_lead_score desc, p.is_acquisition desc, p.gross_approval desc, p.google_review_count desc limit 15;
